p.span:
Base = 0x00000000
Limit = 0xFFFFF
A (Accessed) = 1
R (Readable) = 1
C (Conforming) = 1
T (Type) = 1 (Code segment)
S (System) = 1 (Non-system, code or data)
DPL = 0 (Ring0)
P (Present) = 1
AVL (Available for software) = Any bit
D/B (Default operand size) = 1 (32 bit)
G (Granularity) = 1 (Limit * 4096)

div.p:
Base = 0x00000000
Limit = 0xFFFFF
A (Accessed) = 1
W (Writeable) = 1
E (Expand down) = 0 for data, 1 for stack segments
T (Type) = 0 (Data segment)
S (System) = 1 (Non-system, code or data)
DPL = 0, 1, 2 or 3 (Ring0..Ring3)
P (Present) = 1
AVL (Available for software) = Any bit
D/B (Default operand size) = 1 (32 bit)
G (Granularity) = 1 (Limit * 4096)
